content.short: Opium is a DeFi protocol for creating, settling, and trading decentralized derivatives.
content.description: Opium is a collection of open-source Ethereum smart contracts designed to enable the creation, settlement, and trading of decentralized derivatives. The platform provides a trustless, transparent, audited, and professional derivatives ecosystem for traders. Governance operates through a DAO in which token holders submit and vote on governance proposals, and these decisions determine liquidity mining logic and influence the behavior of the protocol and its shareholders. This arrangement emphasizes a transparent, proposal-based governance process that ties protocol parameters and incentives to token holder participation.
